scope: P2 support in the existing d1 translation implementation

runtime_tests.note: CPU workflow fixtures use a small-width model and an IO-only fake AE; the separate real-AE check below uses the full release model.

existing_documentation_tests.note: Existing documentation issues were not changed or hidden by the P2 update.

limitations: Synthetic checks establish execution, not full-dataset convergence or paper-result reproduction.
P2 retains the existing d1 and MDSA implementation; it does not align every setting with the paper.
Measured CUDA allocations can exceed physical GPU capacity on this Windows host; this is not a guarantee of fitting in 10 GiB on another system.
